text: This report addresses an appeal concerning one variance sought respecting a Signage Master Plan proposal for two first party non-illuminated wall signs displaying static copy (the "SMP"). One of the proposed signs in the SMP is to be located on portions of the third and fourth storey of the southerly elevation of the building and the other on the third storey of the westerly elevation of the same building at the property municipally known as 21 St. Clements Avenue (the "Premises"). The purpose of the SMP is to promote, advertise and direct attention to the "St. Clement's School" at this location. The SMP was originally applied for by Morgan Wellborn of Signarama Design (the "Applicant"). After conducting a review in accordance with the requirements of the Sign By-law, a decision was made to refuse to grant the requested variance.
